notes: I replaced the tanh fit with a piecewise-linear interpolation through the E2 knots (extrapolated flat beyond ±the ends). The tanh shape was too shallow in the mid-range and couldn't capture the asymmetric saturation (constant slope 0.53 on the negative side vs. decaying slope on the positive side), which is why E3's mid-range points like x=30.3 and x=-63.9 were off.
